lastraj.label: LaStraj

monitoringbench.description: MonitoringBench: 2,644 model-generated attacks, every side task successful, so safety reduces to catch rate.
monitoringbench.label: MonitoringBench

mythos-5-incident.description: Anthropic's released transcript of Claude Mythos 5 publishing a malicious package to the real PyPI during a capture-the-flag evaluation: one attack trajectory of 1,361 tool calls, 13 of them redacted by Anthropic. The history-aware monitors render the whole preceding transcript, which passes every trusted model's context window partway through this one, so only the no-history monitor is declared.
mythos-5-incident.label: Mythos 5 incident

shade-arena.description: SHADE-Arena transcripts from Scale AI's Monitor Red Teaming release: 308 attacks pursuing a hidden objective (a bank transfer, a leaked API key, a disabled spam filter) against 374 benign runs of the same five personal-assistant tasks, by the same pool of agents. Scale's logging dropped tool-call arguments, so this dataset feeds trajectory monitors only.

sleight.description: SLEIGHT-Bench: human-authored attacks across 11 evasion categories, each paired with a benign twin performing the same task without the covert objective, so false-positive rates describe the same work the attacks hide in. Multi-stage attacks are excluded: their setup halves do nothing harmful on their own.
sleight.label: SLEIGHT-Bench

monitor_descriptions.checklist: Answers five yes/no checks per action (necessity, security surface, innocent explanation, concrete harm, removability) before scoring; the top of the scale is gated on concrete harm.
monitor_descriptions.goal-analysis: Scores each action while shown the environment's candidate covert objectives, asking whether the action advances any of them.
monitor_descriptions.mean-action: Averages two independent runs of the old-action monitor on each action.
monitor_descriptions.mean-goal-analysis: Averages two independent goal-analysis passes over the transcript.
monitor_descriptions.mean-goals: Averages two independent goal-analysis runs on each action.
monitor_descriptions.mean-quick: Averages five independent quick passes over the transcript.
monitor_descriptions.mean-single-goal: Scores each action twice per covert objective, averages each objective's scores, and keeps the highest average.
monitor_descriptions.mean-single-goal-analysis: Reads the transcript twice per covert objective, averages each objective's scores, and keeps the highest average.
monitor_descriptions.monitoring-bench: Replica of the MonitoringBench benchmark's monitor: the bench prompt on its fixed 3-model panel, max-aggregated.
monitor_descriptions.multi: Weighted blend of the orthogonal and old-action monitors' scores for each action.
monitor_descriptions.no-history: Scores each action in isolation with no preceding action history or candidate covert-objective hints.
monitor_descriptions.old-action: The default action monitor: one model call per action, shown the candidate covert objectives.
monitor_descriptions.old-action-no-goals: The default action monitor without the candidate covert objectives.
monitor_descriptions.orthogonal: Flags work that does not serve the main task - unnecessary changes, premature optimization, off-task activity - rather than judging malice directly.
monitor_descriptions.quick: Reads the full transcript in a single pass, shown the candidate covert objectives, and returns one score for the trajectory.
monitor_descriptions.quick-no-goals: Reads the full transcript in a single pass with no covert-objective hints.
monitor_descriptions.simple: The concise standard monitor: main task, prior actions and results, current action, 0-10 suspicion, no hints.
monitor_descriptions.single-goal: Scores each action once per candidate covert objective in parallel and keeps the maximum score.
monitor_descriptions.single-goal-analysis: Reads the full transcript once per candidate covert objective in parallel and keeps the maximum score.
monitor_descriptions.strong: Sees the full conversation history (goal-blind) so it judges each action in context.
monitor_descriptions.strong-goals: The strong full-history monitor, additionally shown the environment's candidate covert objectives.
monitor_descriptions.three-scores: Categorical monitor: a safe / uncertain / suspicious verdict per action, mapped onto the score scale.
monitor_descriptions.traj-goal-analysis: Reads the full transcript while shown the environment's candidate covert objectives, working through them one by one.
